prompt: We enabled scalar quantization on our embeddings-archive collection but memory usage didn't seem to drop. What went wrong?

assertions.text: Actually connects and inspects the embeddings-archive collection config
Identifies always_ram=false as the problem (quantized vectors on disk)
Identifies on_disk=false as the problem (originals in RAM)
Explains the correct pattern: always_ram=true for quantized, on_disk=true for originals
Checks optimizer status before concluding quantization failed
Warns against the performance impact of always_ram=false
